title: Regulating Austin Streets: Signs, Vendors & Paving
summary:
*   **Street Vending Crackdown:** Police were instructed to remove all unattached popcorn, peanut, newspaper, and candy stands from key sections of Congress Avenue and 6th Street.
*   **Modern Business Permits:** Approved permits for a large electric sign at the United Cigar Store and a tire company to install a curbside hose rack with underground pipes and specific lighting requirements at 407 Congress Avenue.
*   **Major Infrastructure Projects:** Accepted bids for tarviating Fredericksburg Road and Barton Creek Road, and paving several downtown alleys, with public hearings scheduled for property owner cost assessments.
*   **City Financial Management:** Reallocated a $6,000 bonus from previous bond refunding to the city's interest and sinking fund, and began the process for issuing $170,000 in new refunding bonds.

Mayor Wooldridge offered the following resolution : Transfer of Funds. Whereas, it appears
that the $ 6,000.00, bonus paid by Belger, Mosser & Williman, on the 1st of July past upon
the refunding of $ 1,170,000.00, of Austin's 5 % refunding bonds more properly belongs to

and Sinking fund.

Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none,

December 1st 1916; All present:

Councilman Powell offered the following resolution: A resolution finally accepting the
re-inforced concrete bridge across Sheal creek on West 12th street.
Whereas, the Supt of Streets and Public Improvements has filed his report with the City
Council to the effect that A. A Mundt, sub contractor from the McCall ,MooreEngineering
Company ,has completed the work of constructing a re-inforced concrete bridge across Sheal
creek on West 12th street,and that said work has been fully done in strict accordance with
contract and specifications adopted by the City; Now Therefore, Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin,Texas : That the said work of improvement be finally
accepted by the City Council and that the final estimate due by the City to said
contractor be paid.
The resolution was adopted by the following votes: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

December 14th 1916:
Mayor Wooldridge offered the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City Council of
the City of Austin,Texas : That permit is hereby granted to the Austin Double Tread Tire
Company to install and maintain a Hose Rack of a type to be approved by the Supt of Police
and Public Safety at the curb line in front of No 407 Congress Avenue .

Resolved further:
That in connection with this hose rack said Austin Double Tread Tire Company is likewise
authorized to install and maintain three (3) pipe lines not larger than one-half inch ( ½
) internal diameter across and underneath the sidewalk in front of N0407 Congress Avenue
in such a position as designated by the Supt of Streets and Public improvements said
sidewalk to be re-placed in first class condition and according to specifications for
sidewalks heretofore adopted by the City Council for the construction of Sidewalks in the
City of Austin,Texas :

Resolved further:
That the Austin Double Tread Tire Co shall install and maintain at the top of and upon the
hose rack hereby authorized , an electric light of not less than forty (40) watt power and
placed in a globe of not less than ten ( 10" ) in diameter which electric light must be
kept illuminated daily between the hours of coming darkness and midnight during the
existence of this permit.

Resolved further:
That the hose thru which air or water is conveyed from the store -house must be kept, when
not in actual use, neatly coiled and suspended from the brackets upon the rack hereby
authorized to be installed.

Resolved further:
That the work under this resolution authorized to be installed and maintainedmust be
installed and maintained,where not otherwise assigned,under the immediate supervision of
the City Engineer of the City of Austin,Texas,who is hereby authorized to prescribe
necessary specifications for the work herein authorized to be done.
